About

Marketing that sounds human and is built on data.

I work as a digital marketer across strategy, content, SEO, email and community, the parts of marketing that decide whether a brand is heard or scrolled past. What draws me in is the connection between a creative idea and the numbers that follow it.

My practice is built on brand storytelling and content strategy: finding the way a business actually talks, then giving that voice a calendar, a channel plan and a reason for every post. From there it is community growth, search visibility and campaign planning, adapting to whatever the goal is while keeping strategy at the core.

I start with audience research rather than assumptions, then use analytics and performance tracking to check whether the work is doing what it was meant to do. My technical background shapes how I approach that: audit before assuming, test in a structured way, and treat data as something to interpret carefully rather than decorate a slide with.

Most of all I like helping businesses explain their value plainly. A lot of good companies lose customers simply because their message is harder to understand than it needs to be.

Services

How I can help your business

Practical marketing support, scoped to where you are right now.

01

Digital Marketing Strategy

A clear plan that connects your business goals to the channels, messages and audiences most likely to move them.

02

Social Media Strategy & Management

Channel direction, brand voice and day-to-day posting so your presence stays consistent instead of sporadic.

03

Content Planning & Creation

Editorial calendars, campaign concepts, blog and landing page copy built around what your audience actually searches for.

04

Community Growth & Engagement

Conversations, replies and community routines that turn passive followers into people who trust the brand.

05

Search Engine Optimization

Keyword research, on-page fixes and site audits that help the right people find you without paying for every click.

06

Email Marketing

Campaign emails and simple flows that keep customers close and give a reason to come back.

07

Paid Ad Strategy Support

Audience definition, message testing and structure so ad spend is guided by a plan rather than guesswork.

08

Research, Analytics & Reporting

Competitor and audience research, engagement reporting and A/B testing so decisions are informed by evidence.

Every engagement is tailored, so services can be combined or scaled to fit your goals, timeline and budget.
